covered.label: National Rail
covered.detail: Every train calling at Nottingham Station and this region's other stations, from the UK's national real-time feed.

partial.label: Nottingham Express Transit (NET) tram
partial.detail: On the catalog, but Nottingham's tram operator has no confirmed live-times feed — its stops aren't offered in the station picker or Near me for now, rather than being selectable and then showing an error. They stay on file for when a confirmed feed exists.

stations: 111 stations and stops: 107 National Rail stations across the East Midlands (13 Sep 2026 UK station fill; 2 more — New Mills Central/Newtown, Derbyshire — reassigned in from rest-of-england 15 Sep 2026, docs/jim-brief-rest-of-england-reassignment.md) plus the NET tram. Nottingham Station's rail platforms and the tram viaduct are shown as two separate entries.
